C-FIX-009-SESSION-COLD-START.IntentSummary: Bind the welcome "Last session" row to the boot-time snapshot held by the editor store, gate it on skipped-auto-restore, and surface restore results. Store-first: the component reads one reactive getter, so the row cannot drift from reality again.

MustContain.Text: skipped restore (preference off) records the boot-time snapshot as the offer

T-001.Title: Store: boot offer snapshot + restore result

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: BOOT_SESSION, when restore was requested but the preference is false, freezes the complete payload (lastSessionTabs + lastSessionFolders + lastSessionActive) once into coldStartSession when tabs are non-empty; the auto-restore path leaves it null. RESTORE_SESSION returns { folders, tabs, skipped } and clears the offer when at least one item restored.

recent/index.vue renders the row only from editorStore.coldStartSession (summary + count); the row click calls RESTORE_SESSION with the frozen offer ({ from }) and raises the localized nothing-restored notice when folders+tabs are zero — the click never rereads live preferences.
recent.lastSessionEmpty exists in all ten locale catalogs as native copy with exact minified derivatives.

T-004.Title: Tests: preference branches and the zero-tabs mid-run gate

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit cases pin all four boot corners; component cases pin the row hidden mid-run after the autosave emptied the preference; browser coverage extends the welcome zero-tabs state.
M-011 SummaryDelta, V-M-011 scenario entry, the train FIX-009 record and evidence.json reflect the implemented behavior; grace lint is clean.

C-1.Name: Preference on, cold launch, snapshot non-empty
C-1.Expected: Auto-restore runs (C-69 path unchanged); coldStartSession stays null; welcome (if reached later) shows no Last session row.

C-2.Name: Preference off, cold launch, snapshot non-empty
C-2.Expected: coldStartSession = boot-time tabs; row visible with that summary; data never changes afterwards even as autosave rewrites the pref.

C-3.Name: Preference off, cold launch, snapshot empty or absent
C-3.Expected: coldStartSession null; no row; no error.

C-4.Name: Mid-run close-all with preference on
C-4.Expected: Autosave writes the empty session; welcome shows no Last session row (component no longer reads lastSessionTabs at all).

C-5.Name: Row click, all paths restorable
C-5.Expected: Folders+files open in saved order, active selected; coldStartSession cleared; row disappears.

C-6.Name: Row click, every path missing
C-6.Expected: Result counts 0 restored; localized notice visible; never silence.

C-7.Name: Row click, partial restore
C-7.Expected: Existing paths open, missing skipped (existing behavior); marker logs skipped count; no notice (something restored).

C-8.Name: Crash before first autosave
C-8.Expected: Snapshot from the previous run intact (C-69 guarantee untouched); next cold start offers it again.

C-9.Name: Preference toggled mid-run
C-9.Expected: Only the boot-time value matters for the offer; toggling later does not conjure or remove the current run's offer retroactively; next launch follows the new value.

C-10.Name: Second window / multi-window
C-10.Expected: BOOT_SESSION runs per window bootstrap; a second window with restore=false (files passed) never sets coldStartSession; the welcome of the first window keeps its own offer.

Correctness.Note: Single source of truth: the component stops reading ipcPrefs for the row; the store owns the snapshot. RESTORE_SESSION return value is additive, so the auto path cannot regress. Autosave timing (400 ms) untouched. Concern raised and resolved: clearing coldStartSession inside RESTORE_SESSION also runs for the auto path — harmless because auto path leaves it null by construction.

Security.Note: No new IPC, no persistence, no path leaves the renderer beyond the existing mt::open-file flow. The notice message is static localized text; no path data in it.

UX.Note: The owner verbatim requires "never silently no-op" — the all-missing notice satisfies it; partial restore stays quiet (something happened). Row disappears after a successful restore so it cannot advertise a consumed snapshot. Mid-run the row is simply absent rather than erroring.

Performance.Note: One extra pref read at boot (already read today by the gate); the computed adds no watchers beyond one store getter; RESTORE_SESSION result object is negligible.
